name: Schloss Naudersberg
beschreibung: Schloss Naudersberg perches on a hill above the village of Nauders in the Tiroler Oberland, near the border with Italien and Schweiz. The historic building fabric of the castle was restored for holiday apartments, while old architectural elements were preserved. Guests stay amid the mountain landscape of the Kaunertal, with access to hiking and cycling trails as well as the ski area.
